name: @heytraders/openclaw-plugin
description: Origin-pinned OpenClaw tool plugin for the live HeyTraders browser command catalog.

scripts.clean: node --input-type=module --eval "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.plugin:build: npm run build && openclaw plugins build --root . --entry ./dist/index.js
scripts.plugin:check: npm run build && openclaw plugins build --root . --entry ./dist/index.js --check
scripts.plugin:validate: npm run build && openclaw plugins validate --root . --entry ./dist/index.js --json
scripts.verify: npm test && npm run plugin:check && npm run plugin:validate
